proposed.evidence: A temporary observation offset is visible starting around index 560 and ending around index 584. During this interval, the N component shows a sustained positive shift (up to +3 MAD), while the E component exhibits a corresponding positive shift (up to +4 MAD). Simultaneously, the U component displays a significant negative shift (down to -7 MAD). This multi-axis excursion persists for approximately 25 days before abruptly returning to baseline levels across all three components, consistent with a temporary data processing or antenna phase center anomaly rather than physical deformation.
